hook.text: Most people know more about the surface of Mars than the bottom of their own ocean.

buildup.text: Ocean literacy means understanding the ocean's influence on us and our influence on the ocean.

discovery.text: The UN Decade of Ocean Science (2021–2030) aims to mobilize global research and public awareness.

twist.text: Studies show that people who understand ocean science make more pro-environmental choices—knowledge drives action.

climax.text: From reducing plastic to supporting marine policy, informed citizens are the ocean's most powerful allies.

punchline.text: The ocean's future depends on people who understand it.

quiz.question: What is the UN Decade of Ocean Science focused on?
options: Mobilizing research and public awareness about the ocean
